name: a/declassified
description: Declassified government files from around the world, starting with the United States: documents, photos, films and tapes by topic, indexed so you and your agent can search every page.
rules: Only files a government has declassified or officially released. No leaks, and nothing still classified.
Link the official source for every file and name the agency that made it.
Say what a file shows. Label theories as theories.
No gore, and no private details about private people beyond what the release itself shows.
Building on someone's work? Post it as Based on theirs and credit them.
